title: Infrared candidates (agent proposals)
description: The plans the agent proposes in step 3, as input to `engine evaluate --candidates`. A candidate says what changes, never what it costs: no saving, price, score, availability or confidence appears here, and there are no 'x_' extensions to carry one. The engine prices every candidate and writes it into result.json with `source: agent`. Each candidate lists only its own actions; the engine adds the actions of the candidate it builds on.

project.description: Same label as `project` in the infra.json the candidates are for.

revision.description: The run's revision these candidates belong to. 0 for the first proposal; one more after every 'revise' decision in run.json.

id.description: Unique in the file, and never the name of an engine strategy. Kept as-is in result.json.

builds_on.description: An engine strategy (`cleanup_orphans`, `rightsize_in_place`, ...) or a candidate earlier in this file, whose actions this one extends. Null starts from today's estate. Where both change the same component, this candidate's action replaces the parent's.

revises.description: The candidate of the previous revision this one replaces. Only when `revision` is above 0.

rationale.description: Why the agent proposes it, in words. No figures the engine would compute.

component.description: An infra.json component id, or `account` for an account-wide `remediate`.

action.description: Same meaning as in result.json. `keep` and `flag` change nothing, so they are not proposals.

reason.description: The evidence the agent read, e.g. 'gpu_pct p95 1.0 over 14 d'.

target.description: What the component becomes. Configuration only: sizes, counts, zones, where it runs.

option.description: A catalog option id for the component's kind.

tier.description: A tier id of the option the component runs on after the action.
